## What and why

Describe the problem and what changes for someone using Lettrine. Link the issue if there is one.

## Checks

List what you ran and anything still unchecked. For interface changes, add screenshots in the light and dark themes.

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] The relevant native scenarios pass, if this changes editing, files or the interface (see Tests in CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] New syntax round-trips: Markdown → blocks → DOM → Markdown gives back the same text.
- [ ] New interface text is in `src/locales/en.json`, `zh-Hans.json` and `zh-Hant.json`.
- [ ] The changelog and any affected README instructions describe the change in behavior.
